title: Eric closes Day 1 in Amsterdam: 'Companies are being murdered in the name of profit'
summary: Gill hosts the Leadermorphosis podcast and ran an accountability session at the summit. Her recap of the first day closes on Eric's talk, delivered remotely, which she calls a rallying call.
blockquote:
"Companies are being murdered in the name of profit."

The powerful line we heard at the end of Day 1 of the global Corporate Rebels summit from Eric Ries, author of The Lean Startup and Incorruptible.
